# bind: each kind of value
bind id name done ratio
bind nothing missing
bind state tags empty
bind state.type state.since.day state.missing state.type.deeper

# bind: what it refuses
bind id id
bind state.type state_type
bind a-b
bind .id
bind id.
bind state..type
bind
as scalar str text
bind @scalar id

# with: the variables exist while the command runs
with id name state.type -- transcript__show_bound id name state.type
with id -- transcript__with_again
with id -- true
with id -- false
with -- transcript__show_bound id

# with: what it refuses
with id name
with id --
with id id -- true
with a-b -- true
